before: At Roden Law, we handle all personal injury cases — including claims for injured children — on a contingency fee basis. This means you pay nothing upfront and owe no attorney fees unless we recover compensation for your child. We advance all case costs and expenses. Call 1-844-RESULTS for a free, no-obligation consultation about your child's injury claim.
